data.narrative:
LeoLabs is a Series B space and aerospace company that has raised $94M to date. Valuation triangulation draws on two applicable methods against a comparable universe of 5 public and 8 private peers in the same sector and stage cohort, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $94M raised proxy, yielding $179M. The Peer-Median method anchors to a median valuation of $1.5B across the 5-company same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peer set, which ranges from $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-Comp anchoring is not applicable because LeoLabs' revenue is not disclosed; the sector median P/S multiple across 6 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) is 23.9x but cannot be applied without revenue data.

The two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of $152M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $839M. The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty: Stage-Progression suggests modest step-up from capital raised, while Peer-Median pulls toward higher valuations observed in the private space sector. Key sensitivities are revenue trajectory, technology differentiation relative to peers, and the stage at which the company targets its next funding event.
